facts.fact: Max 的豪宅是租的——她想起自己长大的更大宅子与每月派对（夏日小屋里戴耳机躲笑声）
facts.anchor: I grew up in a mansion, bigger than this one.

facts.fact: 她其实看到了 Max 昨晚删掉的那条短信
facts.anchor: I not only read it, I also

facts.fact: 她不许 Max 陪课：Bailey 正不跟你说话，让他单独享受
facts.anchor: Let him have this time doing something he enjoys without you butting in

facts.fact: Max 的恳求：帮我确认 Ted 没有对 Bailey 做过更多那种事——他不会跟任何人讲
facts.anchor: I need to know that he didn’t do more stuff like that to Bailey

facts.fact: 她答应试着帮 Bailey 问出实情
facts.anchor: I’ll see what I can do. I’ll try and help him.

facts.fact: 章末：本来只想幻想他，现在开始在乎他了
facts.anchor: that tiny insight into his life has me starting to care about him
